verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's Request Changes Workflow (reviews.request_changes_workflow in .coderabbit.yaml) posts a blocking request-changes review whenever it leaves actionable inline comments. It approves only after approval requirements are met, and the docs show a GitHub PR blocked by that review. The workflow is also described as synchronized with resolved feedback and Pre-Merge Checks, which covers the core blocking-review gate. Missing for 10: documentation of a required status check, gating scoped specifically to critical-severity findings rather than any actionable comment, confirmation of blocking behavior on platforms beyond GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
